text:
amy: quick check — I found a discrepancy between Python and TS SDKs when calling POST /v1/models/:id/predict. Python omits optional params when they're None, TS sometimes sends empty strings which our REST layer treats differently. can we decide a consistent behavior?

jordan: can you paste minimal repro payloads?

amy: yep. Python (requests) body we send:
```json
{"prompt": "hello", "temperature": null, "top_k": null}
```

amy: TS (fetch) we're seeing this shape from the client lib when callers pass defaults:
```json
{"prompt":"hello","temperature":"", "top_k":""}
```

rahul: oof. server side we parse temperature as number (optional). empty string -> parseFloat('') === NaN. in some codepaths we coerce NaN -> 0, elsewhere we 400. inconsistent behaviour across routes.

sam: which route? predict v1 or v2? parsing code differs. v1 uses express validator that treats '' as present string -> validation fail, v2 has a layer that does Number('') -> NaN -> fallback 0.

marissa: this explains intermittent regressions in evals — some tests saw temp 0 unexpectedly.

jordan: two levers: 1) normalize at ingress: treat '', 'null' as missing for numeric/boolean fields; 2) change SDKs to avoid sending empty-string for non-string typed params. prefer both but SDK fixes are safer long-term.

amy: +1. For TS SDK we should ensure serializer omits keys that are undefined or empty-string for typed numeric/bool fields. For Python we already omit None.

rahul: agree. Also update OpenAPI: explicitly mark numeric/boolean fields with nullable: true vs allowing string. and add example showing omission vs null. that will help SDK generator.

sam: minor implementation detail: TS JSON.stringify will include empty-string if property exists. we need the helper that strips falsy values for non-string types (but careful with 0 and false). rule: remove key if value === '' || value === undefined || value === null. do NOT remove 0 or false.

marissa: can we add an incoming middleware for safety: coerce input for these fields: if typeof val === 'string' && val.trim() === '' -> treat as undefined. log a debug metric for these events.

amy: I'll open two PRs: one in sdk-js to change serialiser + unit tests, and one for api-ingress that adds a small middleware and OpenAPI notes. will link PRs here when ready. tagging @jordan @rahul for review.

jordan: thanks. add migration note for Dedicated customers if behavior changes (they may be on older runtimes). maybe middleware behind feature flag first.

amy: noted. initial PR will be behind feature flag defaulted on staging. PR text will include expected request/response samples.

deploy-bot: deployment status: staging cluster healthy — no rollout until PRs merged. :rocket:

marissa: action items: 1) amy open SDK PR (sdk-js) 2) amy open ingress PR (platform) 3) rahul update OpenAPI spec 4) jordan add release note draft.

amy: assigned. PRs in progress — will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
